title: Light Mustardy Canadian Broad Beans Noodles
description: A Canadian dish featuring broad beans, ferment-kimchi, and a light mustardy sauce, this recipe is low-calorie-friendly and perfect for adventurous eaters. It combines chewy noodles with the crunch of broad beans and the spice of kimchi.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the noodles according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the garlic until fragrant.
Add the broad beans to the skillet and cook until they are tender but still crisp.
Stir in the mustard, soy sauce, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the ferment-kimchi to the skillet and stir to combine.
Drain the cooked noodles and add them to the skillet, tossing to combine with the broad bean and kimchi mixture.
Serve hot, garnished with additional kimchi and broad beans if desired.
Let the dish cool completely before refrigerating or freezing for later use.
Reheat the dish in the microwave or on the stovetop before serving.
